costSource: AliExpress per-SKU price from window._d_c_ and cross-checked against the DSers Import List stable cost for destination United States, which reads $13.32~$50.36. The bottom of that range equals the listing's own minimum exactly, and the 20x23cm variant sits at the bottom, so there is no promo gap on the variant we sell.
dutyRateBasis: Canada HS 9405.11.00 (electric lighting fittings designed for LED) / 9405.19.00 (other), MFN column, 7%. Canada applies no Section 301 equivalent to these goods - its surtaxes on Chinese imports cover electric vehicles, steel and aluminium - so MFN is the entire stack. The deeper difference from the US is the BASE: this 7% is charged on VALUE FOR DUTY, which is the supplier price, where the US charges its 41.4% (HTS 9405.11.80) on retail. About CA$2.04 a unit against US$40.57.
verdict: Priced at CA$119.00, which converts to $85.00 at the 1.40 planning rate - well under the RULE 2 ceiling of $103.49 (median $89.99 x 1.15). Contributes $62.17/unit on the binding 'prepaid' basis and $24.29 on 'billed', against a $12.00 floor - clears comfortably either way. Supplier cost of $13.38 is well under the $34.01 rule 19 ceiling for this category, which is why the headroom is this large. Top competitor review count 921, so the category is not locked. CAUTION: the listing has only 77 sold, so supplier social proof is thin compared with the 500-1,000+ behind the other offers; per-SKU depth at 5,771 units is the reason it was taken anyway. The gate is a floor, not a CPA test - $62.17 clears all three measured CPA benchmarks ($31.16-$47.93) and $24.29 clears none of them.
supplierSkuUnitCapMethod: Read as skuStock from the SKU table in window._d_c_ on item 3256804155598662, joined per-variant to skuPriceInfoMap. The DSers card figure of 22,774 is the SUM across all variants on that listing and must never be read as per-SKU depth.
retailNote: Repriced 2026-09-13 from the US-derived price to CA$74.99, just under the CA$75.42 amazon.ca band median rather than at the CA$86.73 ceiling. The old prices (CA$133 / CA$139 / CA$119) were set against the AMERICAN band, whose medians run US$87-107, so every one of them was breaching rule 22 by CA$32-52 for as long as it was live. Mid-band rather than at the ceiling is a judgement, not a rule: contribution is CA$26.80-40.06 either way, and a store with no reviews facing listings that carry 255+ in this basket alone is better off inside the band than at the top of it.
